scope: Independent bounded review of visible pixels in exactly the eight supplied D1756 captures; not production-runtime or complete-course acceptance.
observations: en-desktop-whole: The relativity of simultaneity heading and Printed page 243 are visible above the English lesson. Paragraphs, bold statements, separators, both diagrams and the concluding prose render in a continuous column with no blank content region or visible page-edge overflow.

en-desktop-polarization-viewport: Despite its filename, this capture shows the simultaneity lesson opening. The two bold introductory statements, absolute time emphasis, clock-setting example and synchronized emphasis are readable and separated from adjacent lines.

en-desktop-fig-220: The complete K_1: spacecraft rest frame heading, A and B markers, both c labels, Midpoint light source annotation, O_1/C/X_1/Y_1/Z_1 labels and Light: c in both directions footer are legible. Subscript glyphs are visible, and no label is cut off by the image boundary.

en-desktop-fig-221: Both a Emission in K and b Later in K panels are visible. Flash emitted at C, C: emission location, the v arrow label, solid and dashed axis identifiers, A/B/c markers and the complete light-speed footer are readable. Midpoint dashed guides meet the annotation area, but do not prevent reading the annotation words.

en-mobile-whole: The English heading, body, bold conclusion and final paragraph remain inside the narrow page column. Figure 220 and Figure 221 captions are readable and centered below their respective figure windows, without overlapping the following prose.

en-mobile-polarization-viewport: The title and Printed page 243 fit the visible width. The bold opening statements and absolute time paragraph wrap onto separate readable lines. The last paragraph continues beyond the bottom of this finite viewport; this is not a missing-content finding.

en-mobile-fig-220: The visible left portion has readable Y_1, Z_1, O_1, B, c and C labels. The heading and midpoint/footer annotations continue beyond the right edge of the figure window. This is the disclosed intentional inner-scroll presentation, not a claim that their offscreen text was inspected.

en-mobile-fig-221: The visible left portions of both panels have readable B, O/O_1, C, K/K_1, Y/Y_1 and Z/Z_1 labels, with distinguishable solid and dashed axes. Panel titles and longer annotations are cut at the right figure-window edge as expected for the retained wide figure; the unseen right-hand labels are not certified.

Visible mathematical notation consists of inline symbols and frame/origin subscripts, including A, B, K, K_1, O and O_1. These render as glyphs rather than raw markup in the inspected prose and desktop diagrams; no standalone displayed equation was visible to assess.

In the desktop whole capture, Figure 220 and Figure 221 captions are separate from diagram labels and surrounding paragraphs. Across the inspected pixels, no unintended text-on-text overlap, blank figure, missing-glyph box or prose spilling past the page edge was observed.
limitations: PASS applies only to the visible pixels in the eight bound captures, each inspected once in one batch. No additional image, reopen, crop or reviewer-created derivative was used.

The retained 640px figures intentionally use inner horizontal scrolling on mobile. Only their captured left-hand windows were inspected; offscreen pixels, complete mobile figure-label readability, scroll affordances and unseen scroll interaction are not certified.

functions.view_image automatically resized en-mobile-whole.png from 390x8050 to 291x6000 for presentation. Its whole-page observations concern the displayed overview; native-resolution certification of every small glyph is not claimed. No reviewer-generated resized image was created.
The two polarization-viewport filenames contain captures of the simultaneity lesson opening, not a polarization passage. Only the content actually visible in those captures was judged.

Retained machine Chinese aria metadata for Figures 220 and 221 is disclosed by the supplied text evidence. It is not visible pixel content, was not exercised with assistive technology, and this review makes no full English accessibility claim.

The supplied report identifies isolated offline headless native course HTML. No browser, production page, headed acceptance, application run, test, dependency operation, database operation or paid generation was performed.
The approved simultaneity prose was not edited. Source fidelity, geometry, scientific correctness, generation provenance and earlier Chinese approvals were not rerun or newly certified.
No N124 preparation, other lesson evidence or parent work was duplicated. The only written artifact is this review JSON.

perViewJudgments.judgment: Visible English course text, inline notation and both numbered captions render without unintended clipping, blank rendering or page overflow.
The actually visible simultaneity opening has legible title, metadata, prose and emphasis with no visible overlap.
Complete diagram headings, annotations and symbol/subscript labels are readable and contained in the capture.
Both complete panels and their labels render legibly; no boundary clipping or annotation collision prevents reading.
Visible prose, inline notation and captions stay within the page; wide-figure clipping is confined to the intentional figure windows. Whole-image native-resolution glyph certification is excluded.
Visible simultaneity opening wraps cleanly inside the mobile page. Content continuation below the viewport is not treated as unintended clipping.
Visible left-window labels are readable and nonblank. Intentional right-edge figure clipping is accepted only within the disclosed inner-scroll contract; unseen content and scrolling are excluded.

Visible left portions of both panels render readable labels and axes. Intentional right-edge figure clipping is accepted only within the disclosed inner-scroll contract; unseen content and scrolling are excluded.

findings.finding: The visible English simultaneity prose, inline identifiers and numbered figure captions render without an observed blocking readability defect, blank rendering, unintended overlap or page overflow.

Full desktop figure labels, including subscripts and the two Figure 221 panel headings, are readable. Dashed midpoint guides pass through the annotation area but do not make the annotation words unreadable.

Mobile figure titles and longer annotations visibly continue beyond the right figure-window edge. This matches the disclosed intentional 640px inner-scroll presentation and is not a revision finding; complete offscreen labels and scroll behavior remain unreviewed.
The supplied polarization-viewport filenames show the opening of The relativity of simultaneity. The verdict concerns that actual visible content and makes no polarization-passage claim.
